title: Steps to create Local Fund Transfer – Exiting beneficiary

steps.text: Login to the mobile application, Land on accounts dashboard (account landed in the debit account number) and click Transfer
From Exiting Beneficiary  ,  Select Beneficiary from List
Enter beneficiary details (Purpose of transfer , Charges option) , and  Enter amount
Transfer currency can be selected from drop down list ,Enter description (optional field)

Click on next to preview transfer details 
 a. Confirm: proceed with transfer  
 b. Back arrow to edit transfer details  
 then  Transaction will be submitted

OTP validation 
 a. If this is a new beneficiary, OTP will be sent to mobile number registered on core for validation. 
 b. If existing beneficiary is selected, payment will be processed without OTP
